nameOrigin: core element of diamond and other minerals

pokedexEntries.x: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

pokedexEntries.or: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

pokedexEntries.y: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It’s occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

pokedexEntries.as: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It’s occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

pokedexEntries.su: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

pokedexEntries.mo: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

pokedexEntries.us: Some say that deep beneath the surface of the world, a pack of Carbink live with their queen in a kingdom of jewels.

pokedexEntries.um: To keep the jewels on their bodies free of tarnish, packs of Carbink use their soft manes to polish one another’s jewels.

pokedexEntries.sw: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.
